_about: jarvis tuning — every gesture/camera number the stage reads at boot (GET /tuning). Fitted to THIS hand with the clinic (P sampler / K clinic / the tape). Edit, then `bin/board.sh '{"a":"reload"}'`. Missing keys fall back to the stage's built-in defaults (identical to these).

detector._: MediaPipe HandLandmarker confidences. detect = fresh detection (the busy-background ghost wall, 0.65); presence/track = keeping a hand once found (0.45: a marginal second hand, once found, is kept).

hands._: THE HANDS: identity + grace + smoothing. graceMs = how long a vanished hand stays a ghost (no tap/fling fires). gate = max wrist travel (normalized) to re-match an id. euro = One-Euro filter (minCutoff: lower = steadier at rest; beta: higher = sharper in motion). cursorLerp = the cursor's per-frame chase toward the pinch point (1 = raw).

pinch._: THE PINCH. Three admitting signatures (any one): CONTRAST (frontal OK-sign: backMean-f8 > contrast && backMean > backFloor), PROFILE (aspect < profileAspect && tRel > profileT), CURLED (this hand's natural pinch: tRel > curledT && aspect > curledAspect; clinic 2026-08-23: pinch t .64-.70/a 2.80-3.41 vs fist t .12-.52/a 2.06-2.63). Touch = 2D gap ratio under the ceiling (gapFrontal / gapRotated for aspect < profileAspect) OR THE WORLD LANE: metric thumb-tip/index-tip distance from MediaPipe's world landmarks under worldTouchCm centimetres (orientation-proof; 0 disables). Release: ratio >= relSlow, or relFast when the hand moves faster than fastSpd px/s (two frames running). emaBar = the charged-EMA admit bar. sanityAspect = palm aspect above which the hand is a hallucination.

tap._: a tap = pinch released within ms, travelling under px

fling._: a throw = peak pinch speed over peak px/s with follow-through >= follow of peak at release (fitted: deliberate fling 1526, casual release <= 128, attempts 447-579 @ 1920x1044)

claw._: force pull: the open-flash -> claw window, and how long the lit target strains before the snap unlocks

clap._: THE STRIKE READ: two upright (handUp > up) open hands closing at >= closing px/s, then both vanish

light._: THE LIGHT GOVERNOR. floor = raw hand-zone luma below which FAST is too dark to lift (-> LIGHT after darkMs); back = return to FAST when est. FAST luma > floor*back for brightMs; target/gainMax = the software lift; toneMax = highest ISP tone rung allowed (clinic verdict: 1).

tape._: THE TAPE: seconds of per-frame anatomy kept for `cmd dump`; raw = also keep the 21 raw landmarks + world gap per hand (what tools/replay.py replays)
